# Benchmark Suite Fixtures

Use this directory for deterministic benchmark-suite metadata fixtures, expected
summary JSON, and small project-authored text snippets.

Do not commit full books, generated audio, model files, benchmark run outputs, or
copyrighted corpora. Real-book benchmark inputs should stay local, for example
under `~/Documents/Books`, and generated artifacts should stay under
ignored paths such as `.artifacts/benchmarks/`, `output/`, or `temp/`.
